scenario: 今天的具身赛道在问，策略到底该看什么、记住什么，以及人体经验怎样才能变成机器人用得上的接触。未来预测可以放在视觉语言模型看现在的同一套视觉 token里。标准操作基准上接近饱和的模型，一旦物体挪位或指令改口就会垮掉，稳健性来自把要做什么从训练时的位置和措辞里拆出来。双臂协调可以写进动作分词器，而不把两条手臂当成关节翻倍的单臂。接触密集的操作需要把触觉放回三维空间；人会在哪里动手，也不能直接当成机器人该在哪里接触。空中导航把全局目标记在世界坐标系里，机载端还要把推理跑快。用通用视觉-语言模型做早期安全监测时，只看总准确率会掩盖它几乎抓不住已经不安全的情形。

papers.title: Z-sight: Unifying Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
papers.authors: Junjie Ye, Yiqi Zhao, Muchen Xu, Celina Shiyu Wang, Hao Dong, Ruohai Ge, Rong Xue, Benjamin J Kolligs, Aditya Dutt, Sasanka Nagavalli, Nassim A. Samad, Gaurav S. Sukhatme, Jyotirmoy V. Deshmukh, Yue Wang, Yuliang Guo
papers.summary: 视频世界动作模型用联合生成未来画面和动作来做控制，但像素级生成成本很高；近年的潜在空间策略又往往对齐中间特征，或依赖冻结的外部编码器，把未来预测和视觉语言模型自己的特征空间拆开了。一种统一模型直接在视觉语言模型感知当下的视觉 token 空间里预测未来，用前瞻专家和连续动作专家与主干一起，在推理时联合去噪未来空间 token 和动作，不必重建像素，也不再外接编码器。它在人类视频和机器人轨迹上训练。在 SIMPLE 上成功率达到 81.9%，比最强基线高出 9.6 个百分点；在六项 Unitree G1 真机任务上成功率为 73.3%。==未来预测可以发生在模型看现在的同一套视觉 token 里，而不必再走一条像素生成通路。==
papers.abstract: We introduce $Z$-sight, a unified robot foundation model that couples vision-language-action (VLA) and generative latent world modeling. Video-based world action models (WAMs) show the value of joint future-and-action generation for control, yet inherit the heavy cost of video generators. Recent latent-space policies avoid pixel generation, yet typically align intermediate features or rely on frozen target encoders, decoupling future prediction from the VLM's native feature space. $Z$-sight instead predicts the future directly in the visual token space in which its VLM perceives the present. Coupling a foresight expert and a continuous action expert with the VLM in a mixture-of-transformers, $Z$-sight jointly denoises future spatial tokens and actions at inference without pixel reconstruction or external encoders. Trained on human video and robot trajectories, $Z$-sight achieves 81.9% success on SIMPLE (+9.6 points over the strongest baseline) and 73.3% across six Unitree G1 tasks (+20
papers.score_note: Z-sight：在 VLM 原生视觉 token 空间联合去噪未来状态与动作，SIMPLE 81.9%（+9.6），Unitree G1 六任务 73.3%（+20.0），110 ms/chunk。

papers.title: RageVLA: Augmentation-Trained Perception and Action for State-of-the-Art Robustness on LIBERO
papers.summary: 视觉-语言-动作模型在 LIBERO 上看起来已经接近饱和，可一旦物体挪了位置，或指令换成新的说法，多数模型在 LIBERO-PRO 上就会垮掉。问题往往不是模型不够大，而是该做什么仍然绑在训练时的位置、场景和指令措辞上。一个办法是从两处切断这种绑定：在数据里按通用规则移动物体、改换环境和改写指令；在策略里，感知模块把解耦后的物体清单和位置交给动作模型，再由从头训练的流匹配模型据此行动。约两亿参数的模型在 LIBERO-PRO 上把成功率做到 0.72，已发表的最强模型是 0.53。把给定的物体位置打乱、画面保持不变时，成功率会大幅下降，说明策略确实在按自己看见的布局行动。==稳健性来自把要做什么从训练时的位置和措辞里拆出来。==
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models look saturated on LIBERO, yet most of them fall apart on LIBERO-PRO as soon as an object moves or the instruction asks for something new. We argue that what is missing is not scale but decoupling. In these policies, what to do is tied to where things were during training, to the scene around them and to the wording of the instruction. We cut these ties in two places. In the data, LIBERO demonstrations are re-arranged by general rules: every object and fixture is moved and rotated, tasks are carried into other environments and onto other surfaces, and every instruction is paraphrased. In the policy, a perception engine on frozen DINOv3 features, trained on this augmented data, hands the action model the scene in decoupled form: a list of objects with their positions, and a compact code of what the gripper is looking at, next to image and instruction embeddings from TinyCLIP. A flow-matching diffusion transformer, trained from scratch, acts on this vie
papers.score_note: RageVLA：用规则重排演示以解开动作与训练位置/场景/指令的绑定，瞄准 LIBERO-PRO 鲁棒性。

papers.title: BiCAT: Bimanual Coordination Action Tokenization
papers.authors: Xuanwei Liu, Guipu Cao, Zhongyi Luo, Jiafei Duan
papers.summary: 自回归的视觉-语言-动作模型用离散动作 token 对接机器人，但双臂操作里两条手臂既共享一批动作模式，又靠互补角色来配合。现有分词器大多把双臂拼成一个向量，共同的运动无法共享，臂间依赖也被缠在同一个 token 里。一种面向双臂协调的动作分词让两条手臂共享一套运动表示，并用对称的跨臂注意力和联合解码器，让一侧的 token 看到另一侧。策略再并行预测每条手臂的全部 token，先生成左臂，再以它为条件生成右臂。在十个仿真任务上，平均成功率比八个基线里最强的那个高出 17.6 个百分点；在三个本体的六项真机任务里，150 次试验中成功 113 次。==动作分词器就可以把双臂协调写进去，而不必把两条手臂当成关节数翻倍的单臂。==
papers.abstract: Autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models predict discrete action tokens with the next-token objective of their vision-language backbone, so the action tokenizer defines the interface between the policy and the robot. In bimanual manipulation, the two arms share a repertoire of movements yet coordinate through complementary roles, and an action representation should capture both. However, most existing tokenizers encode both arms as a single concatenated action vector, in which motion patterns common to the two arms are not shared and cross-arm dependencies remain entangled within each token. The policy must therefore learn both aspects implicitly. We propose Bimanual Coordination Action Tokenization (BiCAT), which shares one motion representation across arms while conditioning each arm's tokens on its partner through symmetric cross-arm attention and a joint decoder. The policy then predicts all tokens of each arm in parallel, generating the left arm first and the right arm c
papers.score_note: BiCAT：双臂协调的动作 tokenization，针对自回归 VLA 的 tokenizer 接口。

papers.title: HINT-WAM: Hindsight-Informed Training for World Action Models
papers.authors: Phuong Tuan Dat, Qi Li, Xinchao Wang
papers.summary: 世界动作模型把动作生成和未来视觉动态预测耦合在一起，但事后训练很难把它变成可靠的任务执行。离线监督微调的流匹配动作专家只在加噪的演示动作上学习，从未见过自己采样器产生的中间状态，针对新任务的适配还可能伤到预训练能力。一种事后知情的训练方法用演示的未来视频作为只有教师能看见的信息：学生沿自己的去噪轨迹生成动作，同一模型在这些状态上再看一眼未来视频，给出稠密的动作分布目标。学生部署时仍只看到当时的输入，也不需要环境奖励或仿真器交互。在 LIBERO-90 上，它把成功率从监督微调的 78.88% 提高到 85.18%。==动作专家应当在自己采样经过的状态上学习，而不是只在加过噪的演示动作上学习。==
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) have shown promising generalization and data efficiency in robot manipulation by coupling action generation with predictions of future visual dynamics. Translating these capabilities into reliable task execution, however, remains a challenge for existing post-training methods. Offline supervised fine-tuning provides dense supervision on expert trajectories, but its flow-matching action expert is trained only on noised demonstration actions and never on the intermediate states produced by its own sampler; task-specific adaptation can also compromise pretrained capabilities. On-policy reinforcement learning trains on the policy's own behavior, yet sparse task rewards make exploration and credit assignment difficult, while dense reward shaping still provides scalar evaluations rather than direct action targets. We introduce \textbf{HINT-WAM}, the first on-policy self-distillation framework that supervises the action expert on its own sampling trajectories using
papers.score_note: HINT-WAM：用 hindsight 信息训练 world action model，针对 WAM 后训练与可靠执行。

papers.title: 3DTouch: A Tactile-aware VLA Model with 3D Geometric Relations for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.authors: Xin Zhang, Shiqi Zhang, Siyuan Cao, Juncheng Cai, Yedong Shen, Yuxuan Gao, Dianlong Wen, Kaixue Long, Lu Zhang, Yao Li, Jiajun Deng, Yanyong Zhang
papers.summary: 在接触密集的灵巧操作里，手指和物体常把局部几何挡住，视觉很难完整给出接触位置；看上去差不多的场景，只要相对位置有细微差别，接触状态就可能完全不同。一种方法把场景点和五指上的稠密触觉测量都写到机器人基座坐标系里，保留每个触觉单元的空间位置和力向量，再用手部关键点和对齐后的表面，显式描述手与物体、物体与物体的相对关系。动作专家因此能直接看到对得上的接触力和相对几何，从而调整接触和对齐。在五项真机任务上，平均成功率比对应的视觉-语言-动作基线高 42 个百分点，比最强的对照方法高 20 个百分点。==接触密集的操作需要把触觉放回三维空间里，而不能只看看起来相似的画面。==
papers.abstract: In contact-rich dexterous manipulation, occlusion by the fingers and interacting objects obscures local geometry, preventing visual observations from fully capturing contact locations. Visually similar scenes may also differ subtly in the relative positions of interacting objects, leading to different contact states. Hand-object and object-object relations derived from hand landmarks and pose-aligned reconstructed surfaces explicitly describe the relative arrangement of interacting entities. papers.title: ART: Bridging the Embodiment Gap in 3D Human-to-Robot Affordance Transfer
papers.authors: Zichen Zhang, Wei Zhai, Xuji Zhang, Yang Cao, Yu Kang
papers.summary: 三维可供性常被当作物体上可以交互的部位，直接拿人类标注或预测来指导机器人。可供性其实并不只属于物体，它和执行者的身体结构绑在一起：人手和机器人夹爪接触、稳定物体的方式不同，把人类先验直接用上去，执行时往往会对不上。一份成对数据集给每个物体同时标了人类先验和经过仿真验证的机器人标签。一种迁移网络先滤掉人类先验里几何上站不住的位置，再分层重建，并用图扩散把人和机器人在拓扑上对不齐的可供性对齐成机器人用得上的分布。在六自由度机械臂加平行夹爪的真机评测里，直接使用人类先验的任务成功率是 58.3%，迁移后提高到 86.5%。==人会在哪里动手，不能直接当成机器人该在哪里接触。==
papers.abstract: 3D affordance acts as a critical link between perception and action, providing priors for robotic manipulation. While existing approaches predominantly leverage human priors as direct references, they often overlook that affordance is not an object-intrinsic property but is inherently coupled with the agent's embodiment. Due to the structural and morphological disparities between human hands and robot end-effectors, directly applying human priors causes severe incompatibility for robotic execution. Motivated by this, we introduce a novel task setting, 3D Human-to-Robot Affordance Transfer, which addresses the affordance misalignment arising from distinct embodiment structures. To support this task, we construct the Human-Robot Paired Affordance Dataset (HPAD), the first large-scale 3D affordance benchmark in which every object is annotated with both human-prior and simulation-validated robot labels. papers.title: Allocentric Memory, Egocentric Acting: A Dual-Frame VLA for Urban Aerial Navigation
papers.authors: Haotian Xu, Yue Hu, Zhengqiu Zhu, Tuo Feng, Wenguan Wang, Quanjun Yin
papers.summary: 语言目标的空中导航要求无人机凭飞行中的观察，到达自然语言指定的目的地。难点在于机体视角一直在变，但长距离飞行需要的空间证据却锚在稳定的地点上。一种双坐标系模型把机体观察累积到一张带地理和地标先验的北向上地图里，视角改变后仍能保留证据。再根据指令、当前观察、机体状态和运动历史查询这张记忆，预测地图坐标系里的目标，并由控制器按当前位姿把它转成机体指令。为减少长程中目标来回跳，执行目标被固定为前若干次预测的坐标中位数。在未见过的测试集上，导航误差相对此前最好结果降低 21.2%，路径加权成功率提高 26.1%。==全局目标可以记在世界坐标系里，机体只负责按当前姿态去执行。==
papers.abstract: Language-goal aerial navigation requires a UAV to reach a destination specified in natural language using observations collected during flight. A key challenge is linking changing egocentric perception with spatial evidence anchored to stable locations for long-range navigation. We propose CityNav-VLA, a dual-frame vision-language-action model for urban navigation integrating dynamic egocentric context with persistent allocentric spatial memory. The UAV incrementally accumulates visual observations on a fixed north-up map initialized with geographic and landmark priors, preserving evidence across viewpoint changes. A dynamic query conditioned on the instruction, current observations, UAV state, and motion history retrieves relevant memory evidence to predict a map-frame target. A deterministic controller converts this target into body-frame commands using the UAV's current pose, connecting global reasoning with egocentric execution. papers.title: A Hierarchical Onboard Vision-Language-Navigation Framework for Aerial Robots in Complex Environments
papers.authors: Yuze Wu, Mo Zhu, Xingxing Li, Yuheng Du, Zhaoqi Wang, Yuxin Fan, Wenjun Li, Kenghou Hoi, Zhichao Han, Xin Zhou, Fei Gao
papers.summary: 无人机要在机载算力很紧的条件下做语义推理、决策和长程导航，现有方法仍受三维数据不足、轨迹是否可执行、长程推理和计算效率的限制。一套分层框架把多模态推理和底层控制拆开，先预测三维位姿指令和导航意图，再转成动力学上可行的动作。为缓解数据短缺和域差异，它用三维高斯溅射自动生成逼真飞行数据，并分三阶段训练接地、场景推理和复杂导航；一个带记忆的轻量代理再把长程任务拆开。机载端还做了 token 稀疏化和模型轻量化，在资源受限的飞行平台上把推理加快 7.1 到 9.4 倍，同时保持导航表现。在 AerialVLN 上，成功率达到 78.15%，明显高于端到端的视觉-语言-动作基线。仿真和真机飞行都支持这一套机上部署路径。
papers.abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are expected to achieve semantic reasoning, intelligent decision-making, and long-horizon navigation under strict onboard constraints. While recent foundation-model-driven approaches have shown promising progress toward this goal, existing methods remain limited by challenges in 3D data availability, trajectory feasibility, long-horizon reasoning, and computational efficiency in complex environments. To bridge these gaps, we propose VLN-AR, a hierarchical vision-language-navigation (VLN) framework for aerial robots. VLN-AR decouples multimodal reasoning and low-level control, enabling structured prediction of 3D pose commands and navigation intentions that are translated into dynamically feasible actions. To mitigate data scarcity and domain gaps, we introduce a fully automated 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based pipeline to generate scalable photorealistic UAV navigation data. papers.title: Assessing Vision-Language Models for Early Prediction of Unsafe Situations in Robotics
papers.authors: Muhammad Farooq, Aitor Arrieta, Paolo Arcaini, Shaukat Ali, Thomas Peyrucain
papers.summary: 视觉-语言模型能同时看画面和读指令，看起来很适合在危险发生前预测机器人故障，但支持这一点的证据一直不多。一项评测用 Qwen、InternVL 和 LLaVA-OneVision，在三个机器人案例上分析视频和里程计，把情境分成安全、可能不安全和不安全，并考察不确定性与表现的关系。整体分类和预测可靠性上 Qwen 最强，InternVL 在若干配置里更擅长提前提醒；是否加入机器人状态、历史该留多长，效果取决于模型和评价目标。Qwen 的准确率可以到 73.37%，但对不安全状态的召回率在全部配置里都不超过 1.06%，准确率会被占多数的安全样本抬高。通用视觉-语言模型可以辅助早期安全监测，==但如果优先要抓住已经不安全的情形，只看总准确率会得出过于乐观的结论。==
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) process visual information and textual instructions and, by using their ability to understand and reason about context, are well-suited for predicting robot failures before they occur. However, evidence supporting this remains limited. To address this, we present an empirical evaluation of VLMs for predicting robot failures. In particular, we experiment with Qwen, InternVL, and LLaVA-OneVision across three robotic case studies (HuRoN, Pal Robotics, and CrowdBot), analyzing both video and odometry data for early failure warning (i.e., before an unsafe situation occurs). Specifically, we evaluate their performance in classifying situations as safe, potentially unsafe, and unsafe, together with uncertainty quantified using various metrics, and study the relationship between uncertainty and performance. papers.title: CoRA-VTLA: Contact-Guided Attention and Queryable Response Memory for Tactile Post-Training
papers.authors: Chengye Song, Rui Song, Shengqi Wang, Jiawei Zhang, Hongzhou Wang, Xueyang Guo, Yang Liu
papers.summary: 精密操作里，对准或用力稍有偏差就会卡住或变形，要把预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型适配到这类任务，接触反馈必不可少。可是单帧触觉看不清对近期动作的响应；后训练时若直接把触觉融进去，动作专家的视觉注意力又会被打散，分给接触区域的份额下降。一套触觉模块用可查询的动作-响应记忆取出近期接触响应，和当下触觉一起使用，再用接触引导的注视监督，把视觉注意力集中到指尖接触对应的图像区域。在三个仿真任务上，平均成功率达到 73.33%，同样传感器输入下直接融合触觉只有 50%；在三项真机任务上平均成功率为 66.7%。==触觉后训练要让模型既记得最近一次接触的后果，又把视线留在真正发生接触的地方。==
papers.abstract: In precision manipulation, small errors in alignment or force can cause jamming or deformation, making contact feedback essential for adapting pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models to these tasks. A single tactile observation leaves the response to recent actions ambiguous. Direct tactile fusion during post-training can also disperse the action expert's visual attention and reduce the share it allocates to contact regions. To address these challenges, CoRA-VTLA augments pretrained VLAs with lightweight tactile modules. A queryable action-response memory retrieves recent contact responses so that the action expert can combine them with immediate tactile feedback. Contact-guided gaze supervision concentrates the visual attention of the tactile semantic token on image regions corresponding to fingertip contact. papers.score_note: CoRA-VTLA：接触引导注意力与可查询响应记忆，把触觉用于 VLA 后训练。
